subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Off-Peak Delivery
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Off-Peak Delivery.

hook.text: Trucks deliver at 3 AM when streets are empty. Delivery time drops 50% and fuel use drops 30%.

buildup.text: Off-peak delivery shifts logistics activities to nighttime or early morning when traffic is minimal.

discovery.text: It reduces congestion, emissions, and delivery costs while improving reliability and speed.

twist.text: Noise regulations limit nighttime deliveries. Electric vehicles and silent equipment are enabling a workaround.

climax.text: New York's off-peak delivery program reduced carrier costs by 50% and cut daytime truck traffic.

punchline.text: Deliver when the city sleeps. Everybody wins.

quiz.question: What enables nighttime deliveries in noise-restricted areas?
